_comment_nas_shared: KB-on-NAS deployment, client side. --config is required, not optional: an MCP client launches this from your project directory, so config discovery would never find /var/lib/kb-mcp/kb-mcp.toml and the server would start with default settings — including bge-small-en-v1.5 against an index built with bge-m3, which fails the model check at startup. Mount the share so its PARENT is on local disk: .kb-mcp.db is created next to kb_path and must stay off the network filesystem. See README.md / README.ja.md.
_comment_alwaysLoad: alwaysLoad: true is a Claude Code v2.1.121+ option that ensures kb-mcp's tools are present at initial load (skips tool-search lookup latency). Other MCP clients (Cursor, etc.) ignore the field. Drop it if first-startup model download cost outweighs the latency win.
